The tallest is Marcus Bingham at 213 cm. The youngest is Johnny Juzang (born 2001) and the most experienced Melih Mahmutoglu (born 1990). Beyond Turkey, the squad draws most on USA (7), Denmark (1) and Gabon (1). Nicolo Melli and Sertac Sanli are back for another spell at the club.
